fact: GUCE and APECCAM signed a convention on 28 April 2023 letting foreign-trade operators pay customs and DGI duties, taxes and fees on e-GUCE through member credit institutions with GIMAC; e-Guce Payment has served customs duties since 2012.
title: GUICHET UNIQUE-APECCAM
publisher: Guichet Unique des Opérations du Commerce Extérieur (GUCE)
